about_the_game:
Turn your passion for tabletop games into a thriving business! In Tabletop Game Shop Simulator, you run your very own store, selling wargame miniatures, rulebooks, and accessories while creating a community hub for hobbyists. Whether you’re managing stock, organizing epic game nights, or assembling the rarest miniatures, every decision shapes your success. Will you build the most legendary game shop in town?

Manage your Shop

As the owner, every aspect of the store is in your hands. Set prices, design the layout, and create the perfect atmosphere to attract new customers. Hire and train employees to handle the cash register, restock shelves, or even assist customers with painting and assembling their miniatures. Keep an eye on your finances, handle supply and demand, and make sure your shop becomes the ultimate destination for tabletop enthusiasts.

Manage your Stock

Stock your shelves with everything a tabletop gamer could want! Order miniatures, rulebooks, paints, terrain pieces, and gaming accessories to keep your customers coming back for more. Choose whether to sell pre-assembled figurines or let customers hunt for rare parts in collectible mystery packs. Adapt your stock to customer demands and market trends.

Collect, Assemble & Paint Miniature

Not just a store owner, you’re also a collector! Open mystery packs to discover rare miniature parts, then assemble and paint them to increase their value. Sell them for profit or keep them for your personal collection. Use a variety of paints and techniques to create stunning, one-of-a-kind figures that will impress your customers and boost your shop’s reputation.

Play Against Your Customers

Your shop isn’t just for selling, it’s a place where players gather to test their armies! Organize tournaments and one-on-one battles against customers to prove your skills. Use your best miniatures and strategies to dominate the battlefield, earning rewards and boosting your shop’s prestige. Will you just run the store, or will you become the local gaming champion?

Expand Your Business

As your store grows, so do your ambitions! Expand your shop to hold bigger events, add more product lines, and attract high-profile customers. Host special game nights, launch exclusive figure collections, and turn your store into the heart of the tabletop gaming community. The more successful you are, the bigger the opportunities, can you create the most legendary tabletop game shop in town?

Get ready to roll the dice and build your dream store in Tabletop Game Shop Simulator!
